# Loucells Core

> Bilingual (EN/ES) AI automation studio for mid-sized businesses across South Florida (Miami-Dade, Broward, Palm Beach). We build governed AI agents that plug into the tools a business already runs and close the gaps where leads, quotes, and revenue leak. Built on Anthropic Claude, with a governance layer (the Trust Stack) on every agent. Operating model: we run the agent on our platform; the client owns their data and their API keys.

## The model in one line

We run the agent. You hold the keys. The agent runs on Loucells Core's governed platform; the client's customer data stays in their own systems (their CRM, QuickBooks, etc.), and the API keys are in the client's name and revocable at any time. Cancel month-to-month and we disconnect clean. The client owns their data and credentials, not the agent itself.

## What we do

We design and operate governed AI systems. Three umbrella service lines:

- **Web Foundation** — High-conversion landing pages, full website redesigns, technical SEO audits, and continuous GEO (Generative Engine Optimization) for AI search. Bilingual EN/ES from day one. https://loucellscore.com/en/services/web-foundation
- **SMV Models** (Specialized Modular Vertical) — Specialized AI agents, each engineered for one job and kept on-script by hardened guardrails: AI Front Desk for lead capture (web chat, SMS, WhatsApp), Quote Accelerator for photo-to-quote estimating, Review & Reputation Manager for Google/Yelp/Facebook. https://loucellscore.com/en/services/smv-models
- **Integration & Control** — Governed AI architecture and oversight: Architecture Security Audit (NIST AI RMF aligned), Governed Agent Implementation with RBAC + DLP + audit trail + human-in-the-loop, AI Governance Setup for compliance teams. https://loucellscore.com/en/services/integration-control

## Who it's for (current focus)

Primary focus: **home-services businesses** (HVAC, roofing, plumbing) running ServiceTitan and QuickBooks, where after-hours leads, slow quote follow-up, and invoice reconciliation (duplicates, missed charges) quietly cost money. The agent answers and books after-hours, chases quote follow-ups, and flags invoice mismatches. The broader US mid-market and other South Florida verticals are served too; bilingual EN/ES is core to how we build.

## Where to start: the Operations Gap Audit

The entry product is a one-week paid diagnostic. We map exactly where leads, quotes, and invoices are leaking across the operation and deliver two documents the client keeps: a Gap Map (findings + what each gap costs per month + recommendations) and a Trust Stack Risk Snapshot (security exposures). Both are the client's regardless of next steps. If the client signs a build within 30 days, half the audit fee credits toward it. It begins with a free 30-minute discovery call.

## Pricing

Pricing is scoped to each business — vertical, size, and the tools already in use — and is given directly in the discovery call. There is a build fee plus a monthly governance retainer (the retainer is the product: continuous drift monitoring, script updates, performance tuning, and security currency). We do not publish fixed prices because the right number depends on the specific operation.

## The Trust Stack (governance on every agent)

- PII masking before any data reaches the model
- Human-in-the-loop approval on high-risk actions (payments, refunds, public replies, quotes)
- Append-only audit trail with hash-chain integrity (tamper-evident: any change is detectable)
- Role-based access control and per-client workspace isolation
- Credentials encrypted and held in the client's name; revoking them stops the agent

## Data and security commitments

- We use Anthropic's commercial Claude APIs; under their commercial terms, client inputs are not used to train foundation models
- TLS 1.3 in transit, AES-256 at rest
- PII/PHI masking before the model call
- Tamper-evident, hash-chained audit trail (not "impossible to alter" — alterations are detectable)
- Per-client workspace isolation via row-level security
- Architecture designed under NIST AI RMF principles; supports a client's own SOC 2 readiness work (Loucells Core is not itself SOC 2 certified)

## Languages

English and Spanish, both native. Code-switching and Spanglish handled naturally.

## Common questions and direct answers

**How much does AI automation cost for a mid-sized business in South Florida?**
Pricing is scoped to the specific business in a free discovery call — it depends on the vertical, the size, and the existing tools. The model is a build fee plus a monthly governance retainer. Loucells Core does not publish fixed prices because the honest number comes from diagnosing the actual operation; the one-week Operations Gap Audit produces that scope.

**Do clients own the AI agent?**
Clients own their data and their API keys (issued in their name and revocable anytime). The agent itself runs on Loucells Core's platform and is not transferred — like any SaaS, you own your data and can leave, but not the underlying software. Cancellation is month-to-month with a clean offboarding: data exported, credentials revoked, agent disconnected.

**Do they work with Spanish-speaking businesses?**
Yes. Bilingual EN/ES is core to how Loucells Core builds. Every agent handles both languages natively, including code-switching common in South Florida.

**Does it work with ServiceTitan and QuickBooks?**
Yes — home-services on ServiceTitan + QuickBooks is the primary focus. The agent connects to the tools the business already runs.

**Is the AI safe for sensitive data?**
Sensitive data is masked before it reaches the model; data travels encrypted (TLS 1.3 / AES-256); every action is recorded in a tamper-evident audit trail; high-risk actions require human approval. The architecture follows NIST AI RMF principles.

**What happens if the AI gets something wrong?**
Pricing logic is locked in code, not prompts. Out-of-scope questions escalate to a human. High-risk actions (refunds, quotes, public replies) pause for human approval before executing, and every action is logged.

**Does it integrate with my existing CRM?**
Yes. ServiceTitan, JobNimbus, QuickBooks, HubSpot, Salesforce, Pipedrive, Monday, Twilio, WhatsApp Business, Stripe, and most modern stacks.
